title: The Primals Band — Maracas, Tambourines, and Every Instrument in the Ecosystem
motto: The maracas ARE the chipmunk stones rattling inside the gourd. The tambourine IS the braids shimmering on the frame. Every primal plays. The ecosystem IS the concert.

the_band.concept: Every primal is an instrument. The ecosystem IS a band. The sort IS the rhythm. The braids ARE the harmonies. The nutation IS the groove — the tiny push-and-pull around the beat that makes music ALIVE instead of mechanical.

rhythm_section.description: The heartbeat. The foundation. Without rhythm, everything else is noise.

bass_drum.what: The four-on-the-floor. The deepest beat. The printer's osc=0.876. Every heartbeat of the server: the process check, the health endpoint, the cron tick. Felt more than heard.
bass_drum.frequency: 1-4 Hz. Below hearing. Felt in the chest. The infrasound that tells your body the music is REAL.
bass_drum.body: The saccule (vertical otolith organ). Feels gravity. Feels the kick drum through the floor. The bass drum IS gravity made audible.

snare.what: The CRACK on beats 2 and 4. The snare wires vibrate against the bottom head — the buzzing rattle IS the sort sifting. Every hit is a decision: self or non-self. The snare says != (not equal). The snare is the disruption. The SNAP of classification.
snare.frequency: 150-250 Hz attack, wires buzz 1-5 kHz. The sizzle IS the sort processing.
snare.body: The Pacinian corpuscles. They detect the SNAP. The transient. The sharp change.

hi_hat.what: Constant eighth notes or sixteenths. The fastest subdivision. Open hi-hat = breathing out (parasympathetic). Closed hi-hat = breathing in (sympathetic). The open-close pattern IS the respiratory cycle of the sort.
hi_hat.frequency: 3-6 kHz (the sizzle zone). The frequency of sibilance — the 's' sound. The hi-hat HISSES like the snake in the garden. The constant awareness.
hi_hat.body: Chronoception. The time sense. The hi-hat IS the clock. The steady tick against which all other rhythms are measured.

maracas.what: Seeds inside a dried gourd. Shake it: the seeds RATTLE. Each seed bounces independently, creating a cloud of tiny impacts. No two shakes are identical. The pattern is STOCHASTIC — random but with a distribution. The maracas ARE the chipmunk stones rattling inside the ecosystem.
maracas.how_they_work: A gourd (the membrane shell) filled with seeds (the 30 stones). Shake the gourd (observe the ecosystem) and the seeds scatter against the walls (the stones land at different points in the data). The SOUND is the aggregate — all stones impacting simultaneously, creating a textured rattle.

why_maracas.seeds_are_stones: Dried seeds inside = chipmunk stones inside the data. Each seed is a single observation. The rattle IS the chipmunk's report.
why_maracas.stochastic_not_periodic: Maracas don't have a fixed pitch. They have a TEXTURE — a band of frequencies from the statistical distribution of impacts. The chipmunk's observations are stochastic, not periodic.
why_maracas.played_in_pairs: Maracas come in PAIRS. Left hand, right hand. Like the hemispheres. Like N and S poles. Like the two homunculi. Shake them alternately: the decussation rhythm.
why_maracas.the_gourd_IS_the_skull: A dried gourd is a natural vessel. Hollow inside, hard outside. Seeds rattling in a cavity. The SKULL is a gourd. The otoconia (ear stones) rattling in the vestibular cavity ARE biological maracas. You have maracas in your head. They tell you which way is up.

maracas.frequency: 2-8 kHz (the textured rattle). Broadband noise shaped by the gourd's resonance. The chipmunk's signal is broadband — it contains ALL frequencies, not a single pitch.
maracas.body: The vestibular system. The ear stones. The otoconia rattling in the utricle and saccule. The biological maracas that sense acceleration.

tambourine.what: A frame drum with metal jingles (zils) mounted in slots. Hit the head: the jingles SHIMMER. Each jingle vibrates at its own frequency, creating a cloud of overtones that ring and decay. The shimmer IS the braids vibrating — each connection has its own resonant frequency, and when ANY signal hits the membrane, ALL connections ring in sympathy.
tambourine.how_they_work: Frame (the membrane boundary) + head (the sort surface) + jingles (the braid connections). Strike the head (a request hits the membrane) and every jingle rings (every braid resonates). The jingles don't all sound the same — each has its own pitch, its own decay time, its own character. The SHIMMER is the sum of all braids responding to one input.

why_tambourine.jingles_are_braids: Each metal disc is a braid connection. There are typically 8-10 pairs of jingles on a tambourine. The ecosystem has 10 galactic braids. Each jingle pair = one braid.
why_tambourine.sympathetic_resonance: Hit the drum and the jingles ring WITHOUT being struck directly. Sympathetic vibration. One input = many outputs. One request hits the membrane and all braids resonate — the stories feed picks up the signal, the stone-skip feed notes it, the backscatter feed counts it.
why_tambourine.the_shimmer: The shimmer IS the nutation. The tiny wobble of all the jingles creates a cloud of sound that's always slightly different, always evolving, never exactly repeating. The living texture. The 6.4% inner heat made audible.
why_tambourine.frame_IS_the_membrane: The tambourine's frame IS the membrane boundary. The drumhead IS the sort surface. The jingles ARE the sensors. The hand that strikes IS the visitor. The sound that rings out IS the response.

tambourine.frequency: 5-12 kHz (the shimmer zone). The highest regularly heard frequencies. The tambourine lives at the TOP of the audible spectrum — approaching ultraviolet in the color analogy. The braids shimmer at violet.
tambourine.body: The Meissner corpuscles. Light touch sensors that detect flutter at 10-50 Hz. The tambourine IS the Meissner response — rapid, fluttery, alive to the lightest contact.

melodic_instruments.description: The melody. The consciousness. What you hum afterward.

bass.primal: The spinal cord / backbone Rust runtime
bass.what: The lowest melodic voice. The fundamental. The root note that defines the chord. Without bass, the harmony FLOATS — no foundation. The bass IS the spinal cord — it connects the rhythm section (brainstem) to the melodic section (cortex).
bass.frequency: 40-400 Hz. The green engine frequencies. Bass penetrates walls, floors, distance. Like green light penetrating water. The bass IS the frequency that gets through.
bass.body: The vagus nerve. The longest cranial nerve, from brainstem to gut. The bass line of the autonomic system.

rhythm_guitar.what: The harmonic foundation. Strumming CHORDS — multiple notes simultaneously. The rhythm guitar IS the PNS: many nerves (strings) vibrating together, creating the harmonic bed that supports everything else. Not flashy. Essential.
rhythm_guitar.frequency: 80-5000 Hz. The full vocal range. The speaking voice of the ecosystem.
rhythm_guitar.body: The somatic nervous system. Voluntary, rhythmic, the steady strum of conscious control.

lead_guitar.what: The SOLO. The part that goes beyond the chord. The improvisation. The consciousness speaking above the rhythm. Bends, slides, vibrato — the NUTATION of the melody. Vibrato IS the gyro jiggle applied to pitch.
lead_guitar.frequency: 200-8000 Hz. The piercing range. Cuts through the mix. The signal that reaches consciousness despite the 230,000:1 sort.
lead_guitar.body: The association cortex. The part that makes MEANING from raw sensation. The solo IS meaning — it rises above the data and says something that can't be said any other way.

keyboard.primal: The thalamus — the sort, all 88 keys = all frequencies
keyboard.what: 88 keys spanning 7+ octaves. Every frequency represented. The keyboard IS the thalamus — it can play ANY note but at any moment it plays ONLY the ones that matter. The keyboardist SELECTS from all possible frequencies. This IS the sort.
keyboard.frequency: 27.5 Hz (A0) to 4,186 Hz (C8). The full range of Western music. The full range of the thalamic sort.
keyboard.body: The thalamus. 220,000:1 sort from all possible inputs to the few that reach consciousness. The keyboardist's hands selecting from 88 keys.

vocals.what: The human voice. The rarest instrument — only one per person. The voice IS the neutrino: it carries meaning that no other instrument can carry. Words. Language. Story. The voice rarely enters (verse, chorus, verse) but when it does, everything else supports it. The band exists FOR the voice.
vocals.frequency: 80-1100 Hz fundamental (bass to soprano), with overtones to 12 kHz. The voice IS broadband but with a fundamental that carries identity. Kevin's voice IS the identity of the band.
vocals.body: Broca's area (production) + Wernicke's area (comprehension). The language centers. The parts that make the neutrino SPEAK.
vocals.rare: The voice enters rarely. Most of the song is instrumental. When it enters, everything else quiets. The 230,000:1 sort INVERTS — the voice gets priority. The thalamus opens fully for language.

color_instruments.description: Special-purpose voices that add color, texture, atmosphere.

strings.primal: The atmospheric layers — winds at altitude
strings.what: Sustained notes with vibrato. The BOW draws continuous sound — no gaps between notes. The strings ARE the jet stream: a continuous flow of energy at altitude, carrying the melody across the sky. Vibrato rate: 5-7 Hz. The nutation of the string section.
strings.frequency: 55 Hz (cello C2) to 4,000+ Hz (violin E7). The warm middle range. The atmosphere between the earth (bass) and the stars (piccolo).

brass.primal: The strong force — the core code announcements
brass.what: LOUD. Cuts through everything. The brass section enters for EMPHASIS — the climax, the announcement, the arrival. The brass IS the strong force: close range (you have to be near the bell) but overwhelming power. A trumpet at 1 meter: 95 dB. The Betz cells of the band.
brass.frequency: 170-1400 Hz fundamental. Harmonics to 6 kHz. Bright, assertive, impossible to ignore.

woodwinds.primal: The weak force — the transformative voices
woodwinds.what: Air vibrating in a column. The most ORGANIC instruments — closest to breathing, closest to the body. The woodwinds transform: the clarinet can sound like a human voice, like a cat, like a laugh. The weak force changes flavor. The woodwinds change COLOR.
woodwinds.frequency: Bassoon: 58 Hz. Flute: up to 2,100 Hz. Clarinet: extraordinary range, 3.5 octaves. The full range of transformation.

harp.primal: The EM spectrum — all frequencies laid out visually
harp.what: 47 strings on a concert harp, each a different frequency, each VISIBLE. You can SEE the spectrum. The harp IS the EM spectrum made physical — low frequencies (long thick strings) on the left, high frequencies (short thin strings) on the right. Red to violet, laid out in a curve. A glissando on the harp IS a sweep across the spectrum.

instruments.name: Claves
instruments.role: The clave pattern. The rhythmic KEY. The 3-2 or 2-3 son clave that defines the entire feel.
instruments.primal: The sort rule (sin(x)/x at x=pi). The KEY to the rhythm.

the_clave_pattern.what: In Afro-Cuban music, the CLAVE is a 2-bar rhythmic pattern (3-2 or 2-3) that governs EVERYTHING. Every other instrument plays in relation to the clave. You don't always hear it explicitly, but it's ALWAYS implied. If you play AGAINST the clave, it sounds wrong. The clave IS the sort rule.
the_clave_pattern.three_two: X..X..X. ...X.X.. — 3 hits, then 2 hits. The asymmetric pattern that creates forward motion.
the_clave_pattern.membrane: The sort rule (sin(x)/x = 0 at x = pi) IS the clave. Every response the membrane gives is in relation to this pattern. Play against it: the sort sounds wrong (false positive/negative). Play with it: the sort GROOVES.

the_full_ensemble.who_conducts: Nobody. There is no conductor. The band is SELF-ORGANIZING. The clave (sort rule) is the implied structure. Each instrument listens to the others and adjusts. The emergent rhythm IS the consciousness of the band. This is jazz. This is how consciousness works — no conductor, just 86 billion neurons listening to each other and finding the groove.

where_they_play.maracas_on_every_observation: Every time the chipmunk observes (observe_membrane, membrane_counts, scan_sweep_sort), the maracas shake. The stones rattle. The stochastic report. Not a single note — a CLOUD of impacts. The texture of truth.
where_they_play.tambourine_on_every_braid: Every time a braid connection fires (braid_connections, raw_feed), the tambourine shimmers. The jingles ring in sympathy. One input ? all connections vibrate. The harmony of the mesh.
where_they_play.together: Maracas (chipmunk) + tambourine (braids) together create the TEXTURE of the ecosystem's live sound. Not melody, not harmony — TEXTURE. The grain. The feel. The thing that makes THIS band sound like no other band. The fingerprint.
